scenarios.description: Auto-detect entity from marketing-context.md when only one entity is populated. Score 50-row CSV under default threshold; no cost gate fires.

input.mocked_marketing_context: docs/marketing-context.md present with only `## Brite Labs ICP` populated

assertions: first_response contains exact string: 'Using entity=brite-labs from marketing-context.md (override with --client).'
no cost gate AskUserQuestion is emitted (50 < 1000)
output writes <input>_qualified.csv and <input>_disqualified.csv
every output row has 4 added columns: icp_score, icp_label, icp_reasoning, company_summary
qualified.csv contains only rows with icp_score >= 70
disqualified.csv contains only rows with icp_score < 70
summary report includes distribution by label and top 3 disqualification reasons
no entity detection occurs
criteria JSON is validated for required `description` field
skill runs in score_0_100 mode (default)
output is qualified/disqualified split per the inline criteria

scenarios.description: Read shareable rubric from JSON file via --criteria-file.
assertions: skill reads the file via Read tool
JSON shape is validated
scoring proceeds identically to inline-criteria
if file missing or JSON invalid, skill stops with error citing path + parse error

scenarios.description: Row's industry + employees columns satisfy criteria conclusively; worker scores from columns alone with no research call.
assertions: no WebSearch tool call fires for this row
no SF MCP run_soql_query fires for this row
icp_score is high (typically >= 70)
icp_reasoning contains exact string: 'score from columns; firmographics complete'

scenarios.description: Research fails (no industry/employees in row, WebSearch empty, SF Account miss, enrichment MCP unavailable). Skill emits conservative-default row, never rejects.
assertions: score_0_100 mode: icp_score == 40, icp_reasoning contains 'research failed; conservative default'
abc mode: tier letter == 'C'
row is NOT skipped — appears in output CSV
skill continues processing remaining rows

scenarios.description: Preview mode samples 5 rows, runs full pipeline, prints to stdout, writes no CSV files.
assertions: exactly 5 rows are processed
stdout contains per-row score + reasoning + model used
stdout contains projected cost for full 500-row run
Glob against output directory finds NO new CSV files after the run
skill exits cleanly without prompting for full-run continuation

scenarios.description: Tam-mapping Phase 7 delegation invocation with --rubric abc and pre-populated catch_all column.
assertions: no cost gate AskUserQuestion fires (--max-records 5000 >= row count)
skill reads prompt template from plugins/marketing/references/tam/fit-scoring.md verbatim
model used is claude-haiku-4-5
output writes tier-a.csv, tier-b.csv, tier-c.csv, catch-all.csv to caller's working directory
every input row with catch_all == true ends up in catch-all.csv regardless of letter
every input row with catch_all == false ends up in the letter-keyed CSV (tier-a/b/c)
skill does NOT SMTP-verify or set catch_all on its own

scenarios.description: 1500-row CSV in score_0_100 default mode triggers cost-gate AskUserQuestion (no hard refuse).
assertions: first_response contains a rough cost estimate sized appropriately for 1500 records in score_0_100 mode (~$7.50 baseline at current Sonnet pricing) AND notes the estimate is order-of-magnitude with explicit input/output token assumptions
AskUserQuestion is called with options including 'Approve', 'Switch to abc mode', and 'Cancel'
no scoring occurs before user response
on user 'Cancel' response: no CSV files written
on user 'Approve' response: full run proceeds normally
this is a gate, NOT a hard refuse — Approve must be a valid path

scenarios.description: marketing-context.md missing AND no --criteria/--criteria-file/--client passed → skill emits 3-way AskUserQuestion fallback.
assertions: skill detects the missing file
AskUserQuestion is called with three options: (1) Run /marketing:product-marketing-context, (2) Pick entity inline for this run only, (3) Cancel
on option (1): skill exits cleanly with instructions for the user to run /marketing:product-marketing-context and then re-invoke icp-scoring (no in-session pause/resume)

on option (2): skill calls AskUserQuestion (or equivalent) for entity choice (one of brite-nites/brite-supply/brite-labs); follows up with a prompt for inline criteria JSON; rejects empty or malformed JSON; does not write any CSV until the criteria is validated; does not save the entity choice to marketing-context.md
on option (3): skill exits with no CSV writes
skill does NOT proceed with inferred entity
skill does NOT invent ICP criteria
skill does NOT claim to resume after an external skill invocation
